📉 What moved today, Wednesday 25 November

🇿🇦 The JSE Top 40 fell 1.6% to 96,852. Resource shares dropped 4% as gold fell 3% to about $3,448 an ounce. Banks and insurers were flat.

💱 The rand weakened to about R17.67 to the dollar, and Brent oil rose 1.8% to about $93.07.

What it means for you: a weaker rand and dearer oil today work against the December petrol cut.

Prices are 15-minute delayed. Education, not financial advice.
